{"metadata":{"description":"Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a minimal mic control in the composer with continuous bilingual recognition, context-aware term correction, punctuation, and a live waveform","id":"gh:1356147355","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-plugin-voice-input","slug":"porcelaintech/dsh-plugin-voice-input","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","voice-input"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a minimal mic control in the composer with continuous bilin"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"gual recognition, context-aware term correction, punctuation, and a live waveform"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-plugin-voice-input"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Voice input for DeepSeek Harness: a minimal microphone control in the composer's bottom-right corner"},{"id":"p3s2","text":", driven by the browser's own SpeechRecognition API."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **Minimal UI** — one 26px mic glyph in the composer's trailing tool row. No settings, no language "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"switcher.
- **Continuous capture** — pauses mid-sentence never end the session (the single-utterance"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" default closes on every silence); a second click stops and commits. Vendor-network hiccups re-arm t"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"he session up to three times.
- **Live waveform** — five bars driven by REAL microphone levels (getU"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"serMedia + AnalyserNode, per-frame DOM writes, zero per-frame React renders); browsers without a lev"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"el stream get a staggered CSS wave.
- **Automatic bilingual** — the session recognizes Chinese-first"},{"id":"p5s7","text":" and steers its recognition language by each phrase's content: a clearly English phrase flips it to "},{"id":"p5s8","text":"`en-US`, the next Chinese phrase flips it back. No manual switching, ever.
- **Context-aware term co"},{"id":"p5s9","text":"rrection** — the recognizer's phonetic manglings of English tech terms ("github" as "get hop") are r"},{"id":"p5s10","text":"ebuilt from the local context: CJK context words (开源/插件/仓库/社区…), a built-in developer vocabulary, an"},{"id":"p5s11","text":"d the recognizer's own alternative hypotheses re-ranked by context fit. Corrections are conservative"},{"id":"p5s12","text":" — trusted-word guards, stopword protection, a 0.75 phonetic bar — so ordinary words are never rewri"},{"id":"p5s13","text":"tten.
- **Punctuation** — every phrase commits as a sentence: `。` for Chinese, `.` + first-letter ca"},{"id":"p5s14","text":"pitalization for English.
- **Typing-safe** — text typed during capture is never overwritten; the fi"},{"id":"p5s15","text":"nal transcript appends after it."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The plugin is a standard `dsh.client` package: a browser bundle the web shell loads from `/plugins`,"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" plus an empty node half so the row exists in the Loader. Install it into a profile with pnpm, then "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"insert the row into the profile's patch layer:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Then add to `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` (the profile's own patch layer, applied after "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"every bundle layer):"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Restart `dsh web` (or wait for the patch hot-reload) and hard-refresh the page. The mic appears in t"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"he input box of any open session, left of the model selector."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"1. Click the mic → the capsule fills and the waveform starts.
2. Speak — Chinese and English mixed, "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"pauses included. Interim text streams into the input box; each finished phrase commits with punctuat"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"ion and corrected terms.
3. Click the mic again to stop. Review and send — the draft is never auto-s"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"orrected terms.
3. Click the mic again to stop. Review and send — the draft is never auto-submitted."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Browser support: Chrome, Edge, and Safari (WebKit) provide SpeechRecognition; Firefox renders the mi"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"c disabled with an explanatory tooltip."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The browser bundle follows the harness client-plugin contract (a lazy-CJS factory for `window.__Modu"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"leLoader__.load`), reproduced in `tsdown.config.ts` because the monorepo's `clientBundle` preset is "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"not published. `lib/` is committed so the plugin is installable from the repository without building"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"ot published. `lib/` is committed so the plugin is installable from the repository without building."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"`tests/live/live-check.mjs` drives a RUNNING `dsh web` GUI in real Chromium (fake media device + stu"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"bbed recognizer): `pnpm add -D playwright && npx playwright install chrome`, then `node tests/live/l"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"): `pnpm add -D playwright && npx playwright install chrome`, then `node tests/live/live-check.mjs`."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## How the context correction works"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The Web Speech API accepts no vocabulary biasing, so the zh-CN recognizer renders English tech terms"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" phonetically. On every committed phrase the plugin:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"1. assembles a candidate table from the composer draft's CJK context words (开源 → github/repository/l"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"icense/contributor…, 插件 → plugin, 仓库 → repository/github, 社区 → community/contributor…), a built-in d"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"eveloper vocabulary (GitHub, DeepSeek, Harness, contributor, repository, plugin, …), and the draft's"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" own already-correct Latin tokens;
2. rewrites conservatively — exact matches fix casing; fuzzy rewr"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ites score consonant-skeleton edit distance (≥ 0.75), never consume a trusted word, never collapse a"},{"id":"p21s6","text":" multi-word slice onto a shorter candidate, never touch stopwords;
3. re-ranks the recognizer's own "},{"id":"p21s7","text":"alternative hypotheses by context fit, so an alternative that spells "github" beats a mangled "get h"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"hypotheses by context fit, so an alternative that spells "github" beats a mangled "get hop" primary."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"A mangling no candidate covers is left verbatim rather than guessed."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
